jetdeau.name: Jet d'Eau
jetdeau.slogan: Geneva's liquid exclamation mark, rising from the lake.
jetdeau.line: Water leaves a 10 cm nozzle at about 200 km/h, and some 7,000 litres hang in the air at any moment.

stpierre.name: St. Pierre Cathedral
stpierre.slogan: Calvin's plain pulpit under towers you can climb.
stpierre.line: Konrad Witz's 1444 altarpiece here shows what is considered the earliest topographically accurate landscape in Western art: Lake Geneva.

reformationwall.name: Reformation Wall
reformationwall.slogan: Four giants of the Reformation, carved into the old city walls.
reformationwall.line: Unveiled in 1909, the 100 m wall has Calvin, Farel, Beza and Knox at five metres tall, with the motto Post Tenebras Lux.

palaisnations.name: Palais des Nations
palaisnations.slogan: Where the flags of the world line the drive.
palaisnations.line: Built from 1929 to 1936 for the League of Nations, it is now the UN's European headquarters.

cernsciencegateway.name: CERN Science Gateway
cernsciencegateway.slogan: Tubes, bridges and the smallest things in the universe.
cernsciencegateway.line: Designed by Renzo Piano, it opened in October 2023 at the lab where the World Wide Web was born.

waive_area_cap: the region's famous sights are all in the city area; the countryside area has only villages
